_comment: Gallery quality gate, read by scripts/build-gallery.mjs. Plugins failing the gate keep their .vstai in docs/gallery/data but are left out of index.json (not displayed). Instruments: hidden until rebuilt to the deep-detail standard (factory/REBUILD.md) — the params threshold flips them visible automatically as rebuilds land. Effects: pedals/simple studio gear with small real control surfaces are complete at 4-6 params and stay visible; the hideEffects list names builds that model DEEP hardware (multi-engine reverbs, rack delays, vocoders, channel strips, complex compressors) with only a handful of controls — too light until rebuilt.
